blocks.text: AppZones in Microsegmentation are applications grouped together into zones based on the applications' topology and their underlying network connectivity with each other. Admins can use AppZones to segment different resources that use these applications to track usage. The AppZones page gives insight into your organization's complete list of AppZone data. It allows you to monitor and analyze the data for all configured AppZones in your organization.
The AppZones page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of AppZone data in your organization.
View, monitor, and analyze AppZone data for a single workload.
Take appropriate actions based on the AppZone data displayed.
Discover insights about collective AppZone data.

blocks.text: On the AppZones page (Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > App Zones), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the information by Name, Description, and Member Count. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results. By default, no filters are applied.
Refresh the AppZones page to reflect the most current information.
View a list of all AppZones that are configured for your organization. For each AppZone, you can see:
Name: The name of the AppZone.
Member Count: The number of resources connected to the AppZone.
Description: Contextual information about the AppZone.
Click an individual AppZone to view its complete information.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
